title: Torrents
description: Folder torrents over Reticulum - create, share, download and seed.
summary: A torrent client whose unit of sharing is a folder, not a file. A torrent's address is a key (ntorrent1...), so its contents can change without the link ever changing. Create one from a folder on disk, share the link, and let others download it. Pin a torrent to keep a full copy and advertise yourself to the Indexers as a holder - the swarm then stops waking the publisher's phone. Seeds in the background, so a pinned folder keeps serving while the app is suspended.
